title: 1-1-prep-leila-park-alex-nguyen
content:
1:1 prep notes —
Leila (manager) <> Alex (IC, backend infra)
Date: 2026-03-04 (aim to cover main points in 30m)

Goals for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on health of KV cache rollout (status, perf regressions, risks)
- Career / growth checkpoint (next quarter goals, mentorship pairing)
- Remove blockers (infra quota, infra-oncall handoff)
- Align on roadmap priorities and trade-offs for Dedicated autoscaling work

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick wins / highlights (5m)
   - Ask: what went well last sprint? any small wins to celebrate?
   - Note: Alex shipped the prefix-caching telemetry change (INF-482) — ask for post-deploy observations.

2) Blockers & risks (10m)
   - Quota for pre-prod GPU nodes (infra limit) — action: follow up with infra team about temporary bump (linked INF-496).
   - Observed 2% latency tail increase after kernel upgrade on p4 nodes — need to triage if it's model-hotspot or runtime scheduling.
   - Action items to confirm:
     * Alex to reproduce tail-latency pattern on a pinned test rig (due: 2026-03-10).
     * I (Leila) to raise with SRE and request extended tracing window for next rollout (done: create ticket, assigned to Noah).

3) Roadmap & prioritization (8m)
   - Autoscaling policy for Dedicated: trade-off between faster scale-up vs. cost (customer feedback: Dedicated customers prefer predictable throughput).
   - Decision to make: prioritize fast scale-up (short-term) vs. predictable steady-state (long-term).
   - Ask Alex: estimated effort for two proposals (A: faster scale-up w/ burst nodes, B: conservative steady-state + pre-warm).
   - Note: Alex's rough estimates — A: 2 sprints, B: 3 sprints + more infra changes. Confirm in meeting.

4) Career & growth (5m)
   - Check progress on mentorship with Jamie Chen (shadowing infra-oncall).
   - Ask about interest in leading a small project next quarter (owner of autoscaling can be step-up opportunity).
   - Agree on 1-2 concrete goals for next quarter:
     * Goal 1: Reduce 95th percentile latency by 10% for p4 serving on typical workloads (metric: per-route 95th).
     * Goal 2: Lead design for Dedicated autoscaling proposal and present to Eng PMs (due: end Q2).

5) Feedback & open questions (2m)
   - Quick check: how is workload and bandwidth? any concerns about context switching?

Notes / talking points / prompts to use during meeting:
- "Tell me about the KV cache telemetry post-deploy — any surprises?"
- "If we prioritize faster scale-up, what's the single biggest engineering risk?"
- "What kind of support do you need from me to own the autoscaling design?"
- "How is mentoring going with Jamie? Are the sessions useful or do we need a different setup?"

Action items (capture during 1:1) — tentative before meeting:
- Alex: reproduce latency tail locally and create short repro doc (due 2026-03-10) [JIRA: INF-496]
- Leila: request extended tracing window with SRE and link traces to INF-496 (due 2026-03-05)
- Alex + Leila: draft two autoscaling proposals (A/B) with rough cost/benefit estimates (share by 2026-03-17)
- Alex: prepare a 10-min design walk for the autoscaling option he prefers (schedule for 2026-03-24 design review)
- Leila: connect Alex with Product (PM: Sofia Morales) to capture customer constraints (dropped-in via slack @sofia)

Follow-ups (post 1:1) — things I'll do after the meeting:
- Update INF-496 with notes from the 1:1 and link to trace collection (include action owners + due dates)
- Send a short summary email to Alex with agreed goals and action items (same day)
- Add autoscaling proposals to the next roadmap sync agenda if Alex wants me to present his design

Misc notes / context to keep handy:
- INF-482 (prefix-caching telemetry): Alex's change rolled to staging last week; watch for increased cache hit variance.
- INF-496 (latency tail triage): linked traces show two outliers around 2026-02-21 after kernel bump. Might be scheduling clash with background compaction.
- Customer note: Dedicated customer ACME corp requested SLA clarification on burst behavior (see Confluence CNF-serve-optimizations). We should factor this into autoscaling proposals.

Open questions to resolve later:
- Do we need a dedicated test harness for tail-latency repros, or can we rely on canary traffic?
- What's the expected cost budget for a burst-node design (ask finance for rough capex/opex range)

Prep checklist before meeting:
- [ ] Pull prefix-cache metrics dashboard and highlight any anomalies (Leila)
- [ ] Ensure Alex has links to tracing spans (Noah)
- [ ] Have JIRA tickets INF-482 / INF-496 open and updated
- [ ] Confirm meeting invite + 30m calendar slot

Quick post-meeting template I will send:
- Subject: Recap: 1:1 Leila <> Alex — actions + goals
- Body: 1-2 sentence summary, bullets of action items with owners and due dates, calendar link for follow-ups

Tone notes: keep it collaborative, focus on removing blockers and giving Alex opportunity to lead the autoscaling design. Be explicit about timelines but flexible on scope.

End of doc.
